rungs.title: Junior Developer
rungs.summary: Learning the company's stack and ways of working.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the basics of the stack and asks good questions about the rest.
rungs.delivery: Finishes small, well-defined tasks with review on everything.
rungs.leadership: Keeps their lead informed and learns how the team talks about work.

rungs.title: Developer
rungs.knowledge: Solid in the stack plus testing, security basics and Git; knows where to look when stuck.
rungs.delivery: Takes a feature from ticket to production with light review and writes the tests for it.
rungs.leadership: Explains their work clearly in reviews and stand-ups; starts to help newer people.

rungs.title: Senior Developer
rungs.summary: Owns designs, reviews others' work and raises the standard.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in one area, broad across architecture, data, DevOps and security operations.
rungs.delivery: Designs and delivers whole components; reviews others' work to raise the bar.
rungs.leadership: Mentors, leads a small project and builds relationships beyond the team.

rungs.title: Lead Developer
rungs.summary: Leads a team's delivery and the technical direction.
rungs.knowledge: Sees how the system, the infrastructure and the delivery process fit together.
rungs.delivery: Owns a team's delivery: plans it, unblocks it and answers for quality.
rungs.leadership: Prefers to manage projects over managing people; sets technical direction and grows the team.
